files.content:
name: CI

on:
  push:
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  check:
    name: Typecheck, build and test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      # Bun from package.json's packageManager field.
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version-file: package.json

      # The MCP server and relay run under Node (cli/package.json engines), and the execute sandbox tests run in it too.
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install (extension)
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install (cli)
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
        working-directory: cli

      - name: Typecheck (extension)
        run: bun run typecheck

      - name: Typecheck (cli)
        run: bun run typecheck
        working-directory: cli

      - name: Build (extension)
        run: bun run build

      - name: Build (cli)
        run: bun build.ts
        working-directory: cli

      - name: Test (extension)
        run: bun test ./test

      - name: Test (cli)
        run: bun run test
        working-directory: cli

      # The store zip and npm tarball the release workflow would build, with its artifact checks (permission allowlist,
      # no key, pairing code, source maps or test hooks), so a problem shows up on the PR rather than at release time.
      - name: Release artifacts check
        run: bun run release:check

  browser:
    name: Execute sandbox in headless Chromium (optional)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    # Informational: a real-browser check of the execute sandbox; a failure here doesn't fail CI.
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version-file: package.json

      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install (extension)
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install (cli)
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
        working-directory: cli

      - name: Build (extension)
        run: bun run build

      - name: Build (cli)
        run: bun build.ts
        working-directory: cli

      # The Chromium the pinned patchright-core expects, with its system libraries.
      - name: Install Chromium
        run: node node_modules/patchright-core/cli.js install --with-deps --no-shell chromium
        working-directory: cli

      - name: Execute sandbox browser harness
        run: node --no-warnings test/execute-realm-browser.ts
        working-directory: cli

# Releases browse: the Chrome Web Store zip and the @opencode/browse npm package, from one tag.
#   v1.2.3          stable: npm dist-tag latest, the store item (vars.CWS_ITEM_ID)
#   v1.2.3-beta.4   beta:   npm dist-tag beta, the unlisted beta store item (vars.CWS_BETA_ITEM_ID)
#   workflow_dispatch with dry_run (default true): verify, build, check and attest, never publish
# Tags come from `bun run release <version>` (scripts/release.ts). RELEASING.md has the one-time setup.
#
# verify -> build -> attest -> publish-npm (environment npm) ---------+
#                          \-> publish-cws (environment chrome-web-store) -> github-release
# The artifacts are built once in `build` and passed along; nothing is rebuilt after the checks.
name: Release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+"
      - "v[0-9]+.[0-9]+.[0-9]+-beta.[0-9]+"
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      dry_run:
        description: "Build, check and attest only; publish nothing"
        type: boolean
        default: true

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  # Never cancel a release halfway through publishing.
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Verify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
      channel: ${{ steps.version.outputs.channel }}
      publish: ${{ steps.version.outputs.publish }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          # main's history, to check a stable tag is on main.
          fetch-depth: 0

      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version-file: package.json

      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Version, channel and whether to publish
        id: version
        env:
          EVENT: ${{ github.event_name }}
          REF_TYPE: ${{ github.ref_type }}
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry_run }}
        run: |
          version="$(node -p 'require("./cli/package.json").version')"
          case "$version" in
            *-beta.*) channel=beta ;;
            *) channel=latest ;;
          esac
          publish=false
          if [ "$REF_TYPE" = tag ] && { [ "$EVENT" = push ] || [ "$DRY_RUN" = false ]; }; then publish=true; fi
          if [ "$EVENT" = workflow_dispatch ] && [ "$DRY_RUN" = false ] && [ "$REF_TYPE" != tag ]; then
            echo "::error::A real (dry_run=false) release must run on a v* tag, not ${REF_NAME}."
            exit 1
          fi
          {
            echo "version=$version"
            echo "channel=$channel"
            echo "publish=$publish"
          } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Releasing $version on $channel (publish: $publish)"

      - name: Stable tags are on main
        if: steps.version.outputs.channel == 'latest' && github.ref_type == 'tag'
        run: |
          git fetch --no-tags origin main
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$GITHUB_SHA" origin/main || { echo "::error::$GITHUB_REF_NAME is not on main; stable releases come from main."; exit 1; }

      - name: Install (extension)
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install (cli)
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
        working-directory: cli

      - name: Versions agree (tag, cli/package.json, package.json, manifest) and the changelog is ready
        env:
          REF_TYPE: ${{ github.ref_type }}
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          VERSION: ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          if [ "$REF_TYPE" = tag ]; then
            bun scripts/release-check.ts --versions-only --tag "$REF_NAME" --require-changelog
            bun scripts/changelog.ts check "$VERSION"
          else
            # A dry run from a branch: the changelog entry comes with `bun run release`, so only warn.
            bun scripts/release-check.ts --versions-only
            bun scripts/changelog.ts check "$VERSION" || echo "::warning::changelog/$VERSION.md is missing or not ready; a release tag would fail here."
          fi

      - name: Typecheck (extension)
        run: bun run typecheck

      - name: Typecheck (cli)
        run: bun run typecheck
        working-directory: cli

      - name: Build (extension)
        run: bun run build

      - name: Build (cli)
        run: bun build.ts
        working-directory: cli

      - name: Test
        run: bun run test

  build:
    name: Build and check artifacts
    needs: verify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version-file: package.json

      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Install (extension)
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Install (cli)
        run: bun install --frozen-lockfile
        working-directory: cli

      # The store zip, the npm tarball (with the store item IDs baked in, cli/build.ts), the artifact checks and
      # SHA256SUMS: the same script as `bun run release:check`.
      - name: Build and check the store zip and npm tarball
        env:
          OPENCODE_BROWSER_STORE_ID: ${{ vars.CWS_ITEM_ID }}
          OPENCODE_BROWSER_BETA_STORE_ID: ${{ vars.CWS_BETA_ITEM_ID }}
          OPENCODE_BROWSER_STORE_LISTED: ${{ vars.CWS_ITEM_LISTED }}
          REF_TYPE: ${{ github.ref_type }}
          REF_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          if [ "$REF_TYPE" = tag ]; then bun scripts/release-check.ts --tag "$REF_NAME" --require-changelog
          else bun scripts/release-check.ts; fi

      - name: Release notes
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}
        run: bun scripts/changelog.ts notes "$VERSION" > release/NOTES.md || echo "No changelog entry for $VERSION (dry run)." > release/NOTES.md

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release
          path: |
            release/*.zip
            release/*.tgz
            release/SHA256SUMS
            release/NOTES.md
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  attest:
    name: Attest build provenance
    needs: [verify, build]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    # Only this job mints an OIDC token for Sigstore, and it runs no repository code.
    permissions:
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
      contents: read
    outputs:
      url: ${{ steps.attest.outputs.attestation-url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release
          path: release

      - name: Checksums match
        working-directory: release
        run: sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS

      - id: attest
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-checksums: release/SHA256SUMS

      - name: Keep the attestation bundle with the release
        env:
          BUNDLE: ${{ steps.attest.outputs.bundle-path }}
        run: cp "$BUNDLE" release/attestation.sigstore.json

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: attestation
          path: release/attestation.sigstore.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

  publish-npm:
    name: Publish to npm
    needs: [verify, attest]
    if: needs.verify.outputs.publish == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    # Required reviewers approve before this job starts (RELEASING.md).
    environment:
      name: npm
      url: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode/browse/v/${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}
    permissions:
      # npm trusted publishing (OIDC) and the provenance statement.
      id-token: write
      # gh attestation verify, below.
      attestations: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release
          path: release

      # The files about to be published are the ones this run built and attested (not just consistent with SHA256SUMS,
      # which travels in the same artifact): GitHub's attestation for each digest, signed by this workflow.
      - name: Verify build provenance
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          for file in "release/opencode-browser-$VERSION.zip" "release/opencode-browse-$VERSION.tgz"; do
            gh attestation verify "$file" --repo "$GH_REPO" --signer-workflow "$GH_REPO/.github/workflows/release.yml"
          done

      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with:
          # npm 11.5.1+ for trusted publishing.
          node-version: 24
          package-manager-cache: false

      - name: Publish the built tarball
        working-directory: release
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}
          CHANNEL: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.channel }}
          # Temporary until trusted publishing is configured on npmjs.com; then delete the secret and npm uses OIDC.
          NPM_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.NPM_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
          # Only write a token when there is one, so an empty value never stands in for OIDC.
          if [ -n "$NPM_TOKEN" ]; then
            printf '//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=%s\n' "$NPM_TOKEN" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/.npmrc"
            export NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG="$RUNNER_TEMP/.npmrc"
          fi
          unset NPM_TOKEN
          if [ "$(npm view "@opencode/browse@$VERSION" version 2>/dev/null)" = "$VERSION" ]; then
            echo "@opencode/browse@$VERSION is already on npm; nothing to publish." | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
            exit 0
          fi
          npm publish "./opencode-browse-$VERSION.tgz" --provenance --access public --tag "$CHANNEL"
          echo "Published @opencode/browse@$VERSION with dist-tag $CHANNEL." | tee -a "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

  publish-cws:
    name: Publish to the Chrome Web Store
    needs: [verify, attest]
    if: needs.verify.outputs.publish == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    environment:
      name: chrome-web-store
    permissions:
      contents: read
      attestations: read
    steps:
      # Only for scripts/cws.ts; the zip comes from the build job.
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: |
            scripts
            package.json
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false

      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version-file: package.json

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release
          path: release

      # The files about to be published are the ones this run built and attested (not just consistent with SHA256SUMS,
      # which travels in the same artifact): GitHub's attestation for each digest, signed by this workflow.
      - name: Verify build provenance
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          for file in "release/opencode-browser-$VERSION.zip" "release/opencode-browse-$VERSION.tgz"; do
            gh attestation verify "$file" --repo "$GH_REPO" --signer-workflow "$GH_REPO/.github/workflows/release.yml"
          done

      - name: Upload and submit for review
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}
          CHANNEL: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.channel }}
          CWS_CLIENT_ID: ${{ secrets.CWS_CLIENT_ID }}
          CWS_CLIENT_SECRET: ${{ secrets.CWS_CLIENT_SECRET }}
          CWS_REFRESH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CWS_REFRESH_TOKEN }}
          CWS_PUBLISHER_ID: ${{ vars.CWS_PUBLISHER_ID }}
          STABLE_ITEM: ${{ vars.CWS_ITEM_ID }}
          BETA_ITEM: ${{ vars.CWS_BETA_ITEM_ID }}
        run: |
          (cd release && sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS)
          if [ "$CHANNEL" = beta ]; then CWS_ITEM_ID="$BETA_ITEM"; else CWS_ITEM_ID="$STABLE_ITEM"; fi
          if [ -z "$CWS_ITEM_ID" ]; then
            echo "::error::No store item for $CHANNEL: set the repository variable $([ "$CHANNEL" = beta ] && echo CWS_BETA_ITEM_ID || echo CWS_ITEM_ID) (RELEASING.md)."
            exit 1
          fi
          export CWS_ITEM_ID
          bun scripts/cws.ts publish --zip "release/opencode-browser-$VERSION.zip" --version "$VERSION"

  github-release:
    name: GitHub release
    needs: [verify, attest, publish-npm, publish-cws]
    if: needs.verify.outputs.publish == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          path: release
          merge-multiple: true

      - name: Create the release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          TAG: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}
          CHANNEL: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.channel }}
          ATTESTATION: ${{ needs.attest.outputs.url }}
        run: |
          cd release
          sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS
          {
            cat NOTES.md
            echo
            echo "## Install"
            echo
            spec="@opencode/browse"
            if [ "$CHANNEL" = beta ]; then spec="@opencode/browse@beta"; fi
            printf '%snpx %s install%s\n' '`' "$spec" '`'
            echo
            echo "## Verify"
            echo
            echo "Build provenance: $ATTESTATION"
            echo
            echo '```sh'
            echo "sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS"
            echo "gh attestation verify opencode-browser-$VERSION.zip --repo $GH_REPO"
            echo "gh attestation verify opencode-browse-$VERSION.tgz --repo $GH_REPO"
            echo '```'
          } > body.md
          prerelease=()
          if [ "$CHANNEL" = beta ]; then prerelease=(--prerelease); fi
          if gh release view "$TAG" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            gh release upload "$TAG" --clobber "opencode-browser-$VERSION.zip" "opencode-browse-$VERSION.tgz" SHA256SUMS attestation.sigstore.json
            gh release edit "$TAG" --notes-file body.md
          else
            gh release create "$TAG" --verify-tag --title "$TAG" --notes-file body.md "${prerelease[@]}" \
              "opencode-browser-$VERSION.zip" "opencode-browse-$VERSION.tgz" SHA256SUMS attestation.sigstore.json
          fi

{
  "$schema": "https://json.schemastore.org/package.json",
  "name": "browse",
  "version": "0.0.2",
  "private": true,
  "type": "module",
  "license": "MIT",
  "packageManager": "bun@1.4.4",
  "scripts": {
    "setup": "bun install && cd cli && bun install && bun run build && node dist/cli.mjs install",
    "build": "vite build && vite build -c vite.content.config.ts",
    "dev": "vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --mode development && (vite build -c vite.content.config.ts --watch --mode development & vite build --watch --mode development)",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json",
    "test": "bun test ./test && cd cli && bun test",
    "package": "bun scripts/package.ts",
    "release": "bun scripts/release.ts",
    "release:check": "bun scripts/release-check.ts"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@tsconfig/node22": "22.0.2",
    "@types/bun": "1.4.0",
    "@types/chrome": "0.3.4",
    "@typescript/native": "npm:typescript@7.0.2",
    "vite": "8.2.2"
  }
}

{
  "$comment": "What the store zip and the npm package's extension may ask the browser for. scripts/check-artifacts.ts fails the release when the built manifest differs from this in either direction, so a new permission is a reviewed change here (and a new justification in store/listing.md), never a side effect.",
  "permissions": [
    "alarms",
    "debugger",
    "notifications",
    "offscreen",
    "scripting",
    "storage",
    "tabCapture",
    "tabGroups",
    "tabs",
    "webNavigation"
  ],
  "optional_permissions": [],
  "host_permissions": ["<all_urls>"],
  "optional_host_permissions": [],
  "content_scripts": [],
  "web_accessible_resources": [],
  "externally_connectable": null
}

#!/usr/bin/env node
import { NodeRuntime } from "@effect/platform-node"
import { runMcpServer } from "./mcp.ts"

runMcpServer.pipe(NodeRuntime.runMain)
